title: Using WhatsApp Live Inbox & Sending Transactional Templates

intro.title: WhatsApp Live Inbox & Templates
intro.subtitle: Patient two-way chats, prescription image consultation, and verified Meta HSM templates

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 7, Part 5: Using WhatsApp Live Inbox and Sending Transactional Templates. Managing patient chats directly inside MediFlow streamlines prescription consultations and home delivery support.
Go to WhatsApp Inbox. The conversation thread list displays all active patient chats, unread message badges, and recent timestamps.
Open a chat to communicate in real time, review prescription photos sent by patients, and clarify dosage instructions.
To send pre-approved Meta business notifications, click Templates. Select from verified templates like Refill Reminder, Order Ready, or Digital Bill.
Send the template with automatically filled customer variables. The message delivers instantly with real-time delivery status. This concludes Phase 7!

outro.takeaway: WhatsApp Live Inbox: Engage patients in real-time two-way messaging, review prescriptions, and dispatch pre-approved Meta HSM templates effortlessly.
